Eyelash extensions in South Pattaya

From a natural finish to a fuller lash look, explore the eyelash extension styles in Kannika's menu. The salon is on South Pattaya Soi 16, with hair, nails and foot care available in the same place.

View prices & plan your visit ↗Call the salon ↗

A style to discuss with the salon

Natural and soft natural styles suit a request for a lighter-looking finish. The menu also lists YY / 2D, 3D Volume, Hybrid, Wispy, Cat Eye / Fox Eye and Mega / Russian Volume. Bring a reference photo and discuss the fullness and shape you want before choosing a service.

  • Natural and soft natural
  • YY / 2D and 3D Volume
  • Hybrid and Wispy
  • Cat Eye / Fox Eye and Mega / Russian Volume

Planning your lash appointment

Tell the salon if you have existing extensions and ask which service to book. Confirm the style, price and appointment time directly with the salon. The image on this page is a close-up of a client's lash work at Kannika; it is a reference for that individual result, rather than a promise of an identical finish.

  • Share your preferred style
  • Mention existing lash extensions
  • Confirm the service and price
  • Ask the salon about aftercare

View prices & plan your visit

Check the service menu for prices in Thai baht and confirm the final price with the salon. Online appointment requests need confirmation from the salon.

Before your appointment

Can I choose a natural-looking style?

Natural and soft natural options are listed in our menu. Discuss your preferred finish with the salon when you book.

Is an online request a confirmed lash appointment?

No. Your preferred date and service are sent as a request. The salon confirms the appointment separately.
